# 點(樣) + Verb？ · *dim2 (joeng2) + Verb?*

**Meaning:** how (to do something) · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Asking questions

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fdim2-how).

點 or 點樣 before a verb asks how to do it. 點去…？ ('how to get to…?') is essential for directions.

**Written Chinese:** 怎樣 — Written Chinese uses 怎樣 / 怎麼.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **請問點去中環呀？** |
| Jyutping | cing2 man6 dim2 heoi3 zung1 waan4 aa3? |
| Yale | chíng mahn dím heui jūng wàahn a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄘㄧㄥ² ㄇㄜㄣ⁶ ㄉㄧㆬ² ㄏㆤㄧ³ ㄗㄨㄥ¹ ㄨㄚㄣ⁴ ㄚ³? |
| English | Excuse me, how do I get to Central? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **點樣去機場最快呀？** |
| Jyutping | dim2 joeng2 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 zeoi3 faai3 aa3? |
| Yale | dím yéung heui gēi chèuhng jeui faai a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄉㄧㆬ² ㄧㆦㄥ² ㄏㆤㄧ³ ㄍㄝㄧ¹ ㄘㆦㄥ⁴ ㄗㆤㄧ³ ㄈㄚㄧ³ ㄚ³? |
| English | What's the fastest way to the airport? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **呢個字點讀呀？** |
| Jyutping | ni1 go3 zi6 dim2 duk6 aa3? |
| Yale | nī go jih dím duhk a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄧ¹ ㄍㄛ³ ㄗㄧ⁶ ㄉㄧㆬ² ㄉㄨㆶ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | How do you pronounce this character? |
